/.name: Home
/.description: Project Premier is committed to transforming the lives of marginalized youth across the Greater Toronto Area (GTA) through music, creativity, and business education.

/about.name: About Us
/about.title: About Us
/about.description: A community-driven movement transforming the lives of marginalized youth across the Greater Toronto Area through music, creativity, and business. Our vision rests on growth, reform, and connectivity.

/programs.name: Our Programs
/programs.title: Our Programs
/programs.description: Four hands-on programs for youth across the Greater Toronto Area: Music, Recording Arts, Life Skills, and Business Development. Immersive programs that turn passion into a sustainable career.

/contact.name: Contact
/contact.title: Contact
/contact.description: Reach Project Premier at info@projectpremier.org or visit our studio at 130 Queens Quay East on the Toronto waterfront. Open Friday 5 PM to 9 PM and Saturday 12 PM to 5 PM.

/referral.name: Refer a Youth
/referral.title: Refer a Youth
/referral.description: Refer a young person to Project Premier's programs through our secure referral form. Your referral can make a meaningful difference in a young person's life.

/privacy.name: Privacy Policy
/privacy.title: Privacy Policy
/privacy.description: How Project Premier collects, uses, stores and protects personal information, including information submitted through the youth referral form, in accordance with PIPEDA and, where applicable, FIPPA.
